issue_snapshot.body:
### Story

As a signed-in movie viewer who has provided ratings, I want future recommendations to use my account's rating feedback so that recommendations become more relevant to my preferences.

### Priority

P1 - should have

### Related screen / route

/movies/:movieId, /recommendations

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given an Action candidate and a Comedy candidate have the same base popularity score of 80, when I have rated an Action movie 5 and request recommendations again, then the Action candidate appears above the Comedy candidate.
- [ ] Given an Action candidate and a Comedy candidate have the same base popularity score of 80, when I have rated an Action movie 1 and request recommendations again, then the Comedy candidate appears above the Action candidate.
- [ ] Given an Action candidate has base popularity 90 and a Comedy candidate has base popularity 80, when I rate an Action movie 3 and request recommendations again, then the Action candidate remains above the Comedy candidate because a rating of 3 is neutral.
- [ ] Given rating signals affect ranking, when recommendations are generated, then the complete eligible set is ranked before view filtering and pagination, each page contains at most 10 distinct movies, and every personal recommendation still satisfies BR2.
- [ ] Given a rating signal cannot be applied, when recommendations are generated, then the system still returns a valid preference-based result and does not show an incorrect success message.

### Tasks

- [ ] Prepare a controlled recommendation dataset with equal-score Action and Comedy candidates 
- [ ] Apply a positive ranking signal when a related movie has a rating of 4 or 5 
- [ ] Apply a negative ranking signal when a related movie has a rating of 1 or 2 
- [ ] Preserve base ranking when the rating is 3 because it is neutral 
- [ ] Preserve distinct results and the maximum of 10 recommendations after ranking 
- [ ] Add automated tests for ratings 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 with deterministic ranking order 
- [ ] Read only the current signed-in account's ratings when calculating ranking signals

### Estimate (story points)

5

### Definition of Ready

- [x] The whole team understands what 'done' means for this story
- [ ] It does not depend on an unfinished story from another team member
- [x] It is small enough to finish inside one sprint

issue_snapshot.title: [Story] S06 - Filter recommendations by genre
[Story] S07 - Find content-similar movies from the details page
issue_snapshot.body:
### Story

As someone interested in a movie, I want similar movies ranked using the themes in their descriptions so that I can discover films with related content, not only the same genre.

### Priority

P1 - should have

### Related screen / route

/movies/:movieId

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given the original movie has other movies sharing a genre, when I view the Similar movies section, then I see up to 5 different movies, excluding the original movie, and each shares at least one genre with it.
- [ ] Given no suitable candidate exists, when I open the Similar movies section, then the system shows that no similar movies are available while keeping the original movie details visible.
- [ ] Given similar movies are displayed, when I select one, then the system opens the details page for the selected movie ID.
- [ ] Given two eligible movies share at least one genre with the original movie, and Movie A has a higher TF-IDF cosine-similarity score for its overview than Movie B, when similar movies are displayed, then Movie A appears before Movie B.
- [ ] Given the original movie or an eligible candidate has no overview, when similar movies are requested, then the system does not fail and uses the genre-and-popularity fallback ordering.

### Tasks

- [ ] Prepare deterministic local movie fixtures with genres, popularity scores, and overview text
- [ ] Find candidate movies that share at least one genre with the selected movie
- [ ] Exclude the original movie and remove duplicate candidates
- [ ] Normalise eligible movie overview text for TF-IDF processing
- [ ] Calculate TF-IDF cosine similarity between the selected movie and each eligible candidate
- [ ] Rank similar movies by text-similarity score, then use popularity and title as tie-breakers
- [ ] Use genre-and-popularity fallback ordering when an overview is unavailable
- [ ] Limit the Similar movies section to a maximum of 5 movies
- [ ] Build navigation from a similar-movie card to its `/movies/:movieId` route
- [ ] Add automated tests for text ranking, missing overviews, matching genres, empty results, duplicates, source exclusion, maximum results, and navigation

### Estimate (story points)

5

### Definition of Ready

- [x] The whole team understands what 'done' means for this story
- [ ] It does not depend on an unfinished story from another team member
- [x] It is small enough to finish inside one sprint

issue_snapshot.title: [Story] S08 - Search movies by title or description
issue_snapshot.body:
### Story

As a viewer who knows a movie title or the kind of story I want to watch, I want to search the catalogue by title or description text
so that I can find relevant movies without browsing a long list.

### Priority

P1 - should have

### Related screen / route

/search

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given the catalogue contains a movie titled "Inception", when I search for "Inception", then the result list includes "Inception".

- [ ] Given a search returns more than 10 matches, when the results are displayed, then each page shows at most 10 matches and pagination exposes all remaining matches in the same global order; returning from details restores the submitted query and page.

- [ ] Given I enter fewer than 2 characters, when I submit the search, then the system shows "Enter at least 2 characters".
- [ ] Given the catalogue contains "Moon Rescue" with an overview about an astronaut rescue mission on the moon and "City Robot" with an overview about a detective, when I search "astronaut rescue moon", then "Moon Rescue" appears before "City Robot".
- [ ] Given no movie overview has a positive TF-IDF cosine-similarity score for a valid description query, when I search, then the system shows "No movies found" and does not display unrelated movies.


### Tasks

- [ ] Define title-search, description-search, validation, ordering, and empty-result behaviour
- [ ] Implement case-insensitive title matching with a minimum query length of 2 characters
- [ ] Prepare deterministic local movie fixtures with titles and overview text for search tests
- [ ] Normalise overview text and build reusable TF-IDF vectors after the NLP Spike decision is approved
- [ ] Implement cosine-similarity ranking for valid description-based search queries
- [ ] Rank/select the complete distinct result set before pagination, return at most 10 per page with total/page/revision metadata, and preserve stable title and similarity-score tie-breakers
- [ ] Preserve title-search results and show `No movies found` when no valid title or description match exists
- [ ] Build the search interface with validation, loading, empty, error, retry, title-result, and description-result states
- [ ] Add automated tests for title matching, description ranking, short queries, empty results, complete multi-page coverage without gaps/duplicates, ordering, revision recovery, submit-only queries, detail return and retry behaviour

### Estimate (story points)

5

### Definition of Ready

- [x] The whole team understands what 'done' means for this story
- [ ] It does not depend on an unfinished story from another team member
- [x] It is small enough to finish inside one sprint

### Story

As a signed-in viewer, I want to reset my saved genres and ratings so that I can start receiving recommendations without previous account preference data.

### Priority

P2 - nice to have

### Related screen / route

/profile

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given my signed-in account contains 3 selected genres and 2 ratings, when I confirm reset, then my account contains 0 selected genres and 0 ratings.

- [ ] Given I select reset but do not confirm the action, when I return to my profile, then my existing genres and ratings remain unchanged.

- [ ] Given the reset succeeds, when the operation finishes, then the system displays "Your personalisation profile was reset".
- [ ] Given Account A has 3 selected genres and 2 ratings and Account B has 1 selected genre and 1 rating, when Account A confirms reset, then Account B's genres and ratings remain unchanged.



### Tasks

- [ ] Define reset confirmation and data-clearing behaviour 
- [ ] Implement profile reset for the current signed-in account only
- [ ] Add confirmation and reset tests

3

### Purpose and ownership
Complete the real Sprint 4 Review/wrap-up, outcomes, contribution audit and Sprint 5 handoff. SM4 @anotify-vie owns this standalone issue; PO @kietxuan independently reviews it. Keep C01 Planning separate and preserve SM3 @vu-huzy and the agreed SM5 handoff to @kietxuan.

### Approved M4 testing scope — 1 November 2026
This replaces the earlier requirement to run every backend/frontend/browser regression for each change or reproduce all of them in `docs/testing.md`. The PO requested a compact report and fast default pytest matching the instructor's Milestone 4 rubric. No minimum of hundreds of tests, coverage percentage or new exhaustive UI matrix is imposed.

The six P0 Stories are [S01 #17](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/17), [S02 #18](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/18), [S03 #19](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/19), [S04 #20](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/20), [S12 #44](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/44) and [S13 #45](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/45), including Stories already accepted in Sprint 3.

Each P0 needs at least three meaningful cases, including success, business-rule refusal and below/on/above checks for its numeric business limits. Every Section 2 case must map to an executed pytest in repository-root `tests/`, with its ID in the name/comment. Use isolated temporary data or fake repositories, with no running server, real database, TMDb token or live network. An initial implementation may reuse the current 40 collected P0 cases in `tests/test_p0_acceptance.py` and `tests/test_s03_details.py`; 40 is a reusable baseline, not a new fixed quota. Do not drop a required case merely to reduce the count.

Existing extended backend, frontend, browser and script regressions remain available and are labelled separately. They need not run by default or on every push/PR; use explicit opt-in/manual workflows or a small justified set when the affected code changes. Changing discovery alone does not stop other workflows from running broad suites. Do not delete tests, hide failures, add skips/xfails or claim unrun checks passed. Feature AC/DoD, security, actual functional acceptance and previously committed build/storage/recovery outputs remain; evidence can be reused when its candidate still applies. Replan unfinished work explicitly under C01 rather than silently calling it complete.

### Completion checks
- [ ] Reconcile actual original commitment with Done/unfinished/carried-over/deferred work. Link authentic Planning and Review/cutoff board records, not staged or backdated evidence.
- [ ] Commit the Sprint 4 section of `docs/sprint-log.md` with actual **committed**, **completed** and **velocity**, original commitment versus approved changes, and accepted Story/PR links.
- [ ] Count only newly accepted #22/#24/#30/#33 Points, at most 18, after their own AC/DoD pass. Already accepted #21 and all six P0 are regression and add no repeated Points. Task/Chore Points stay blank; do not turn later zero-Point submission work into Story velocity.
- [ ] Record actual Review/Retrospective attendance, acceptance decisions, lessons and at least one concrete improvement action with owner. A separate `docs/retro.md` is optional; the real team-agreed event/action/handoff still needs evidence.
- [ ] Use #219's compact M4 P0 run: actual command, candidate SHA, count/runtime/output and independent clean-clone/CI links. Do not make re-running hundreds of extended/backend/frontend/browser tests a wrap-up condition.
- [ ] Reuse matching accepted feature and build/index/persistence/recovery evidence; record defects or unaccepted AC truthfully. Narrowing testing.md does not automatically close #22/#24/#30/#33 or excuse unfinished committed work.
- [ ] Audit team minima: at least four merged PRs each reviewed by someone else and at least five Closed issues. For each member record at least one merged PR, one formal review given, one Closed issue and one actually authored pytest in `tests/`, using real PR/file/node/TC-ID evidence.
- [ ] Reuse qualifying Sprint 4 test contributions; do not force an extra standalone test PR per member or invent coauthor credit to fill the table.
- [ ] README explicitly names SM4 @anotify-vie, distinct from SM3 @vu-huzy; C01 remains PO-owned and C02 SM-owned.
- [ ] Record actual G4 decision and admitted trailer outcome/history, current watchlist/stars/half-star/search/pagination scope as accepted, remaining work/hours and any explicit C01-approved deferral. VN providers and planned release revalidation remain Sprint 5.
- [ ] Hand off the selected merged executable SHA, current migration/index/config revisions, setup/recovery runbook, accepted evidence, known defects and remaining scope to SM5 @kietxuan.
- [ ] Obtain PO acceptance and a substantive independent review of the actual wrap-up/log/handoff before closure. Missing/unheld events stay Pending.

### Dependencies and closure
Requires completed/reviewed #216 Planning, #219 final compact setup/build/storage/recovery output and actual acceptance of committed feature/verification work (or an explicitly recorded approved replan). Previously accepted evidence can be reused without a new full-suite rerun.

**No dependency on #218's PDF, submission-day screenshot or LMS receipt.** Give the completed log/Review/contribution/handoff to #218, which finalizes the dossier and submission afterward. At wrap-up record that remaining submission Chore truthfully as Pending if needed; do not claim all Sprint work is Done prematurely.

### Deliverables
Reviewed Sprint 4 log/wrap-up, original-versus-actual board evidence, actual Review/retro action, acceptance/contribution records and concrete S5 handoff. No new product feature or extra large test suite is required.

### Estimate and evidence
Historical baseline: three author hours; reforecast remaining work under #216. Add authentic report/board/event/PR/review/CI/candidate links. Preserve historical dates/commitment/roles; this amendment does not close or tick this issue.

## Related issue

Refs #219.

Keep C05 open until a non-contributing teammate reviews the final changes and records their independent reproduction. Local release verification is complete; no cloud deployment is claimed or required by this PR.

## What changed

- Fixed a real SQLite recovery bug: a destination's hot `-journal` could replay old account data over a restored snapshot. Backup/restore now reject DB/WAL/SHM/rollback-journal destinations before copying and again before publication. Two crashed-writer regressions fail on the old code and pass after the fix.
- Made the two existing P0 files the default M4 suite: **37 logical case IDs, 40 pytest items**, covering S01/S02/S03/S04/S12/S13. Bootstrap tests prove unrelated suites are excluded and configured external databases/indexes remain untouched.

Full backend, Vitest, browser and feature regressions remain available through manual workflows/explicit commands, without silently skipping required P0 cases.
- Updated SETUP and recovery instructions, including `-c pytest.ini` for focused backend commands. Reduced `docs/testing.md` to the instructor's four required sections, preserved all P0 IDs and added full real-output evidence. Historical 820-test logs remain labelled historical.

A separate new temporary database followed the documented application setup:

- Fresh migration to single head `a3d1f8b72c44`.

- `--enrich-trailers --all`: **858 with trailer, 93 without, 0 failed, 0 remaining**.

